limitations: The evidence is confined to the captured LICENSE and the two SPDX files at the supplied data revision. The release-to-commit mapping, policy commit, and bundle digest were supplied as inputs and were outside the six-source acquisition.
The correspondence establishes neither historical applicability to other JOVE editions nor legal equivalence, rights for other works, text reuse, installation, or Index lifecycle.
